evidence: The composition of the film was evaluated using Auger electron spectroscopy (AES) and Rutherford backscattering (RBS) technique. The microstructure and interface between the ZrO2 film and Si substrate were studied using transmission electron microscopy (TEM). The electrical characteristics such as current density-electric field (JF) and dielectric constants were investigated. The capacitance obtained at 100 kHz and 220 V was used to estimate k.
